status: source-researched; not compiled or tested on the target PVE host

passwall_packages.note: Resolve and record a commit providing the chosen release-associated packages; do not silently build moving main.

ssr_plus.note: The current development branch is dev; old master is not the current release baseline.

vlmcsd_recipe.note: Import this recipe, not the entire alternative packages feed.

golang_recipe.note: The OpenWrt release-pinned feed defaults to Go 1.26; Xray v26.9.30 requires 1.27. Pin a suitable upstream recipe commit, following the PW2 SDK workflow approach.

duplicate_package_policy.xray_core: First compatibility candidate: SSR v196.19 recipe 26.9.30-r5, shared with PW2; it adds SSR-specific patches. Validate both generators and live nodes. If compatibility requires separate cores, rename one package and use PW2 global_app.xray_file with a separate binary path. Never let feed order select the provider accidentally.
duplicate_package_policy.mihomo: Use the fixed v1.19.32 source. SSR recipe installs /usr/libexec/mihomo with /usr/bin/mihomo alternative. Provision a separately managed copy at /etc/openclash/core/clash_meta with mode 0755. Disable automatic core replacement until controlled upgrade testing.
duplicate_package_policy.shared_dependencies: Resolve exactly one provider each for dnsmasq-full, ip-full, chinadns-ng, shadowsocksr-libev, geodata and other duplicate feed recipes; review resulting package manifest.

container_adaptation: Use a root-level tar.gz filesystem, with executable /sbin/init; not a combined disk image.
Apply console setup and sysntpd disabling as in the LXC project OpenWrt image recipe.
Apply the LXC recipe's targeted dnsmasq jail adaptation if retaining the default CT confinement; test vlmcsd's procd jail separately and preserve its service user.
Use ostype=unmanaged, one veth on the existing public LAN bridge, and OpenWrt UCI to manage addresses.
Begin with an unprivileged CT, default AppArmor, precise /dev/net/tun mapping; do not default to unconfined or unrestricted device access.
PVE provides nft/socket/tproxy/tun/inet_diag functionality. Do not load OpenWrt-built modules into PVE.
Keep package dependency metadata; do not solve host functionality by force-depends or fake kernel packages.
All three proxy managers must be disabled in a generic template; enable only PW2 after importing and validating the actual configuration.
Disable LAN DHCP/RA; retain IPv4 forwarding and disabled ICMP send/accept redirects.

performance_baseline.cpu_tuning: Generic x86-64 first; AES acceleration comes from userspace implementations. Never use the remote build server's -march=native for an unknown target. Consider v3 only after N100 feature verification and measurements.
performance_baseline.rss_rps: Inspect the PVE-controlled physical NIC and queues; adjust only for measured per-core saturation. Passed-through NICs belong to iKuai.
performance_baseline.bbr: Optional experiment for locally terminated TCP proxy connections, not a universal forwarding or UDP accelerator.

acceptance: Build with make defconfig and inspect effective package providers, dependency closure and manifest.
Audit and remove unused x86 device-default boot/storage packages from the CT manifest, including GRUB utilities and filesystem formatters where dependencies permit.
Provision OpenClash core plus the actual required geodata/rule resources; run all core version/config checks.
Verify CT cold boot, firewall reload, DNS service restart, nft TPROXY rules, policy routing, TCP and UDP forwarding.
Verify ZeroTier creates its TAP interface, joins the intended network, and has the intended direct transport route.
Verify vlmcsd listens and responds on the intended LAN scope.
Validate each proxy manager independently; stop and check cleanup before switching managers.
Preserve .3 domestic DNS, .4 foreign DNS, .4 source-based proxy and independent bootstrap DNS; no recursive interception through .4.
Test ordinary DNS plus fresh uncached domains, ad blocking, TCP and UDP with no unexpected DNS destinations.
Benchmark same-LAN iperf separately from routed direct traffic, proxy traffic and ZeroTier traffic.
A test CT on another address does not fully test foreign ADG return routing: .4 still uses .2 as its gateway until the controlled cutover.
After PVE kernel upgrades, repeat host feature and CT networking validation.

handoff.scope: Clone and build on the designated Linux server; keep all newly created project files, caches, environments, logs and artifacts under the project root.
handoff.maintenance: Create or reuse a GitHub fork when authenticated, preserve official upstream history, use a custom branch, commit reproducible configuration/patches/lockfiles/scripts, and provide tested upstream-stable update/rebuild/regression/rollback procedures.
handoff.target_validation: Build-server kernel validation is not PVE 7.0.14-8-pve/N100 acceptance. Report untested target-dependent items explicitly.
